data.name: Zebulon 3D
data.detailed_description:
Following his last adventure, Zebulon finds himself lost and alone in a new world.

In search for purpose and companionship, he will explore his new environment and discover his lost siblings, of whom will provide new stories, challenges, and powers.

Zebulon 3D is a 3D platformer metroidvania set in a crispy voxelized world with interconnected zones.

Use unlockable powers to discover more of this strange world, find hidden areas, and reveal Zebulon's inner purpose.

The game focuses on traversal mechanics, exploration and story.

Meet the family

  • Zebulon's siblings are scattered around the place, looking for company.

  • Each sibling will reward Zebulon with a unique special power, allowing him to reach new places, open shortcuts, find secrets and adventure further into the world.

  • Siblings hold their part of lore concerning the story of the family and raise concepts of what it can be to be part of a family

  • Each saved sibling will also join you in a nice cosy place and ask you for help with special quests!

Art & Style Legacy

Zebulon 3D inherits its style from "Zebulon : A Lost Cat" which was made in Pico-8

Being a 3D game, Zebulon 3D transforms the 2D style to 3D by switching from pixels to voxels, and reuses the famous Pico-8 colors palettes.

data.short_description: Meet Zebulon once more in a new adventure now in 3D and crispy voxels! Jump, dash, explore, and gather back your siblings in this new exciting game about purpose and family.
